tasks.description: Accept retirement of server notification claim and cancellation writes while preserving history and the current sync read contract.
constraints: English independent Reviewer and QA. Exact read-only candidate diff and local gates. The controller alone deploys to narat-staging and probes the removed endpoint using synthetic sessions. No notifications are sent.

Remove the HTTP writer and both legacy SQL writer RPCs. Preserve historical claims, receipts and current sync projection for existing iOS decoders. New iOS reminder and sync/read retirement are separate. No Auth, billing, quota or StoreKit changes.
